canonical_example.translation: Did you see any opossums? Those critters have been going through my garbage.

canonical_example.text: Era la primera vez que el torero Linares se enfrentaba a un bicho en el ruedo.
canonical_example.translation: It was the first time that the torero Linares faced a bull in the arena.

canonical_example.text: Nahima no era precisamente bella. No había bicho que se quisiera casar con ella.
canonical_example.translation: Nahima wasn't exactly beautiful. There was no living creature that wanted to marry her.

canonical_example.text: Ese niño es un bicho; siempre se mete en problemas.
canonical_example.translation: That boy is a little terror; he is always getting into trouble.

canonical_example.text: Paula era un bicho en la secundaria, pero ahora es hermosa.
canonical_example.translation: Paula was hideous in high school, but now she's gorgeous.

canonical_example.text: No te juntes con ella; es un mal bicho que puede lastimarte.
canonical_example.translation: Don't hang out with her; she's a nasty piece of work that might hurt you.

canonical_example.text: ¿Dónde está ese bicho que hay que poner para llenar la bañera? - ¿Te refieres al tapón?
canonical_example.translation: Where's that thingy you need to fill the bathtub? - You mean the plug?

canonical_example.text: Los bichos se acercaron al heladero corriendo y le compraron dos conos.
canonical_example.translation: The kids rushed to the ice-cream man and bought two cones.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cómo resolviste el acertijo? ¡Eres bicho!
canonical_example.translation: How did you solve the riddle? You're a genius!

canonical_example.text: ¡Bicho! No me sale nada bien.
canonical_example.translation: Ugh! Nothing turns out well for me.
